findings.title: Normal pointer travel disables the only explicit object-details button before it can be clicked
findings.affectedScope: Required hover behavior 4: accessible explicit expansion of the currently inspected object

counterexample.setup: Fresh isolated exact archive or source, 1440×1000 or 1920×1000; enable diagnostic checkbox; hover Image output heading. The summary identifies Node and Read object details is enabled.
steps: Read current footer button bounds without moving the pointer.
Move continuously from the Node heading to the center of Read object details with 80 trusted mouse steps.
Send raw mouse down/up at that location, without locator.click, force, DOM click, or F2.
counterexample.actual: Intervening Canvas/Shader output panels replace the target. Entering footer background resolves no object and clears active. At the button: summary empty, disabled=true, no dialog on mouse down/up.
counterexample.observations: Four of four independent source/archive ×1440/1920 cases reproduce. Raw trusted-event traces and before/after screenshots retained.
counterexample.expected: A person can move from a hovered object to its explicit details action and open details for that object. The route must remain usable while retaining all target/lifetime invalidation fences.

findings.cause: pointerover updates one active target for every crossed element, then unresolved footer background calls clear(); excluding only descendants of .hover-debug-ui does not preserve the route from the object.
findings.existingTestGap: The submitted tests call locator.click on the remote button. Its direct pointer jump avoids intervening hover targets and therefore passes without establishing normal pointer reachability.
findings.requiredRegression: Use continuous trusted mouse paths to the explicit action on exact static archive and source. Confirm intended Node/Port/Widget target, no selection/Graph/History edits, and no stale target after deletion, replacement or remount.

findings.title: F2 reads the latest hovered object instead of the keyboard-focused object
findings.affectedScope: Required hover behavior 4 and keyboard object identity; UI explicitly advertises focused-object F2

counterexample.setup: Fresh isolated exact archive and source, diagnostics enabled.
steps: Use trusted Shift+Tab until Generate GLSL has keyboard focus.
Move the pointer over Image output heading without clicking; focus remains Generate GLSL.
counterexample.actual: Dialog begins Node: Image output, while document.activeElement before F2 is Generate GLSL; Escape restores Generate GLSL. Graph export and Canvas selection equal their pre-probe values.
counterexample.expected: The advertised focused-object F2 action resolves the live keyboard focus and shows UI control: Generate GLSL in this sequence, independently of incidental hover. The pointer details action continues to inspect its own intended target.
counterexample.observations: Independently reproduced once on exact archive and once on source. Separate stationary-pointer, actual Tab-only paths passed in direct and wrapped archive; this report does not falsely claim all keyboard navigation fails.

findings.cause: pointerover and focusin overwrite the same active variable. The F2 handler merely expand.click()s that value and never resolves current focus.
findings.requiredRegression: Cross focused control/Node/Port with a different hovered Node/Panel/UI control, invoke real F2, check exact intended identity and safe focus return. Preserve composition/draft/gesture guards and lifetime checks.
